title: Canon of the Twin Hoar
summary: A canon on laying hoarfrost from both hands at once until it creeps in from either side and closes a guard and a body in cold.

title: Treatise of the Paired Sleet
summary: A treatise on throwing sleet and hail from both hands in crossing sheets that cut a group and blind it and wash the fallen clean.

title: The Azure Zero Mastery
summary: A mastery of cold taken to the lowest point a body can bear so that each strike is judged by how near the cold comes to none at all.

title: Manual of the Dual-Track Stillness
summary: A manual of stilling both tracks of the body in turn so that one side holds a calm guard while the other freezes motion in the foe.

title: The Hawk-Dive Hail Treatise
summary: A treatise on diving from height with a fist of hail and rising from the blow on cold wings that also cover the fallen.

title: The Wind-Sworn Rime Canon
summary: A canon of fine rime that a wind-sworn student lays on the breath at a sworn word and sends along the wind to every mark.

title: Treatise of the Bearing Chill
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing by the chill a warm body casts and holding that line through wind and dark to the end of the cut.

title: The Oath of the Locked Frost
summary: A sworn manual of frost that binds and seals at a spoken word and holds as long as the word is kept.

title: Canon of the Open Hail
summary: A canon of hail thrown in the open with no cover and carried by the wind that bore it to leave the foe nowhere to hide.

title: The Bearing Permafrost Compendium
summary: A compendium on drawing the deep stored cold from the ground beneath a stance and sharing the draw with allies.
